neighbours.label: a digit that is about to be followed by a percent sign, most strongly in a threshold or limit ('below the 3%', '> 10%')
fire: The rules require the deficit to fall below the 3% ceiling by next year.
We reject the null hypothesis if p > 10% in the sample of voters.
The central bank aims to keep inflation under the 2% target.
Loans with an interest rate above the 5% cap were banned.
If a firm owns more than 20% of the shares, it must report them.
Turnout must exceed the 40% threshold for the vote to count.
The fund promised returns of at least 7% a year after fees.
Bonuses are paid only when sales beat the 15% growth goal.
quiet: The rules require the truck to stay below the 3 metre bridge clearance.
We reject the shipment if more than 10 boxes in the sample are damaged.
The central bank meets on the 2nd of every month.
Loans with a term above 5 years need extra paperwork.
If a firm has more than 20 employees, it must report them.
Turnout must exceed 40 thousand people for the vote to count.
The fund opened at least 7 new offices after the merger.
Bonuses are paid only when sales beat the 15 million mark.

predictions: Fires on the last digit of a percentage used as a threshold or limit; quiet on digits in counts, years and measures with no percent.
notes: Probe was weak: 'below the 3% limit' 0.28, '2.4%' 0.10, 'About 7% of respondents' 0.007; non-percent digits 0.001-0.02. Card top examples are all percent figures or numeric coefficients (max 262 on a LaTeX coefficient). Activation is on the digit, so it can only use preceding context. Expect a likely fail on median fire.
